text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED P1 1815554321 Auto-failover invoked after networking instability in eu-north-1. Some traffic still reaching degraded backends; multi-region shift partially completed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/multi-region

sre-evan: Taking pager. Alerts look like: surge in 502/504 from EU edge, p99 token gen latency +900ms in fallback clusters, and spike in cross-region replication RTT.

infra-omar: Cloud provider alert: "network fabric intermittent in eu-north AZs" starting at 1815554200. Health-manager began draining but were seeing split-brain routing because our edge LB pools retained several eu-north endpoints.

net-lina: Observed partial DNS convergence: weighted records shifted but there are a handful of ISP resolvers and partner CDNs still resolving eu-north A records. Also saw a weird path where origin resolves to an edge egress IP, creating an origin<->edge echo.

sre-evan: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) force region weight=0, 2) purge CDN origin cache, 3) kill stale keepalive connections at edge, 4) emergency BGP withdraw + apply route-blackhole if peers still announce, 5) open support bridge for customers.

infra-omar: Executing step 1 now:
```bash
redwoodctl regions update --region eu-north-1 --weight 0 --reason "AZ fabric flaps 1815554200"
```

incident-bot: Action logged: regions update by sre-evan.

net-lina: Initiating BGP withdraw request and will coordinate with peers. Command to provider API:
```bash
provider-api withdraw --region eu-north-1 --prefixes 45.66.0.0/16,52.60.0.0/16
```

infra-omar: Purge kicked off for cdn-origin-group=eu-north-origins. Also bumping autoscaler targets in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 by +25% to absorb traffic.

support-rita: Support bridge up. Notified top impacted customers (payment gateway, CRM partner). Customers report webhook failures and delayed job processing. Estimated affected sessions ~1.6k; concentrated EU traffic error rate ~3.2%.

prod-sim: Drafting customer note: "Were redistributing traffic to healthy regions and terminating stale connections. Retries should succeed; no persisted data loss expected. We will send updates every 10 minutes."

sre-evan: Despite weight=0, still seeing EU-origin IPs in requests. Suspect long-lived sidecar caches + partner CDNs. Need to run sidecar endpoint refresh and then drain edge LBs.

infra-omar: Running staggered sidecar config refresh across EU fleets (5% increments) and initiating graceful drain on edge pool eu-north: 
```bash
edgectl drain --pool edge-eu-north --grace 25
sleep 30
edgectl kill-stuck --pool edge-eu-north --threshold 10
```

monitor-bot: Observability: EU 5xx rate decreased from +50% to +16% in 6 minutes post-purge/drain. p99 latency in fallback regions up +180ms while absorbing additional load.

net-lina: Some upstream ISPs still announce our eu-north prefixes; will request peer flushes. If ads persist, will apply route-blackhole to force fast failure for remaining clients.

sre-evan: Also rolling back an edge affinity tweak deployed earlier today (1815549000) that increased connection longevity. Rolling back now:
```bash
deployctl rollback --service edge-affinity --rev v2027-01-12
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by sre-evan, staged.

support-rita: Customers A and B confirm partial recovery; Customer C (large payments customer) still sees intermittent webhook 502s. Opening a dedicated support bridge with their SRE at 1815554444.

prod-sim: Confirming talking points: retry-backoff guidance, no data loss, ETA for steady state ~20-30m depending on provider.

infra-omar: Provider update: they identified a fabric microburst causing L2 drops; rolling mitigation; ETA 30-50m. Recommend keeping eu-north out of rotation until clear for at least 30m.

sre-evan: Handoff: I'll remain for 15 more minutes then hand to Joel. Joel, can you take monitoring and lead RCA notes?

sre-joel: Taking over at 1815554575. Will watch error budgets, replicator lag, and customer escalations.

net-lina: After BGP withdraw, still seeing small fraction of traffic due to cached partner resolvers. Applying temporary blackhole rule at edge for affected prefixes to force retries to healthy regions:
```bash
edgectl route add-blackhole --prefix 45.66.0.0/16 --reason "force-fail eu-north"
```

monitor-bot: Current state: region weight=0 (confirmed), CDN purge (confirmed), edge drains (in progress), BGP withdraw (partial), sidecar refresh (in progress), rollback (staged). Error-rate trending down but not fully normalized.

support-rita: Notifying customers with update and workaround guidance. Offering per-request logs to the largest impacted partners.

prod-sim: Post-incident action items: review runbook ordering for DNS/BGP/blackhole sequence, add explicit sidecar refresh step, and add a playbook entry for partner CDN TTLs and long-lived TCP sessions. Also evaluate whether alerting thresholds need hysteresis to avoid churn during failovers.

sre-joel: I'll own the postmortem write-up. Keeping pager for 40 minutes. If provider signals green, plan a gradual canary re-introduction: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% with 15m holds and health checks.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to P2 at 1815554685 for monitoring and RCA. Handoff to sre-joel complete. :white_check_mark:
